messages:
Aisha: Quick proposal for next week's triage rota — shrink the live call to 20m, and experiment with a 2-day 'anchor' owner (instead of daily rotation) so the owner has time to follow up. Also add a 10m 'fast lane' at the end for regressions/hotfix triage. Thoughts?

Tom: +1 on the shorter call. 20m feels doable if we keep strict queue priorities.

Ravi: Curious about the anchor idea — how would handoffs work mid-anchor if something urgent comes up?

Aisha: Good q. Option A: anchor stays primary but can hand to the on-call dev with a quick note. Option B: we keep a rotating backup who can accept transfers. Leaning toward B for safety.

Nadia: Can we run this as a 3-week pilot? Week 1: daily owners (current). Week 2: anchor 2-day + fast lane. Week 3: anchor 2-day + fast lane + tight pre-read. Then decide.

Tom: I'm happy to be backup rotation for the pilot. Also can help timebox the call (I'll manage the agenda timer).

Ravi: I'll volunteer for anchor Mon/Tue of week 2. If anyone wants Fri anchor on week 3 I can swap.

Aisha: Nice. Draft agenda I'm proposing (will post to the triage doc):
```
1) 5m - quick status & major regressions
2) 10m - prioritized bug queue (owner assigns next steps)
3) 5m - fast lane (urgent/regression triage only)
```
If we keep the timer strict we can fit it in 20m.

Nadia: Can we add a persistent checklist for anchors in the triage doc? e.g. 'post follow-up, tag owners, escalate to SRE if infra related'. Saves a lot of can-I/should-I questions.

Aisha: Yes — I'll add a checklist and a short handoff template. Template: `Anchor handoff: summary + action items + links (PR/issue) + next anchor`

standup-bot: Meeting created: "Triage (compact pilot)" — week 2 Mon 09:30 — 20m (recurring: pilot weeks only)

Tom: tiny ask — can we label tickets that should be discussed as `triage:discuss` so the agenda owner can pre-sort?

Aisha: Done. Please tag any that need discussion before EOD Fri so anchors can pre-read.

Ravi: :thumbsup: will add mine.

Nadia: I'll update the triage doc with the checklist and pilot schedule.

Aisha: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll run the pilot starting Mon. I'll ping the calendar invite and post the pilot notes in #eng-triage-docs.

Tom: Sounds good.

Ravi: All set from me.
